description: Minimum surface the main window needs: window controls, the event bus that carries `pty:output`, path/app metadata, and the folder picker. The app's own commands (pty_*, workspace_*, project_*, run_tests, preflight) are registered through `invoke_handler` and are not plugin commands, so they are not listed here. The dialog plugin is limited to opening a folder: it is how a student grants the app access to their own repository, and it is the ONLY way a path outside the sandbox is ever established. No filesystem, shell or http plugin is enabled.
